scope: Local Windows diagnostic and gaming-performance workbench for read-only device/package inspection, bounded evidence processing, reports, snapshots and user-approved reversible profiles; not a network service or driver installer.

status_policy.rule: Use implemented or partial only when repository code and focused verification paths support the exact statement. Record limits explicitly. A design document, capability catalog or profile-validation job does not prove runtime behavior.

controls.title: Module boundaries and versioned contracts
controls.assessment: The local evidence transaction and plugin surfaces define explicit in-process extension and mutation boundaries.
limitations: Transactions only produce in-memory snapshots; they do not perform driver, firmware, registry or device writes.

controls.title: Input validation and idempotent state changes
controls.assessment: PE/package inspection and batch processing have bounded parsing paths and targeted regression tests.
limitations: The inspected data is evidence, not an authorization decision; no system mutation is implied.

controls.title: Low-level I/O and transport boundaries
controls.assessment: The workbench performs local file and package inspection through explicit tooling; it does not expose a network listener or remote control interface.
limitations: Local file I/O is in scope; network transport and remote execution are not current product capabilities.

controls.title: Concurrency, scheduling and backpressure
controls.assessment: Batch inspection exists, but a general bounded worker scheduler, queue backpressure and concurrent cancellation contract have not been established.
limitations: Do not infer safe parallel execution or saturation behavior from a batch API name.

controls.title: Memory ownership and resource lifetime
controls.assessment: Inspection batches and archive parsing use bounded input paths with focused tests; complete memory budgets for all UI and report workflows are not established.
limitations: The available tests cover selected inspection paths, not a process-wide memory ceiling.

controls.title: Data integrity and transactions
controls.assessment: EvidenceTransaction provides bounded in-memory snapshots, schema migration checks, generation conflicts and rollback.
limitations: A committed snapshot remains in process memory; it is not a durable database transaction.

controls.title: Failure handling, recovery and lifecycle
controls.assessment: A resilience policy and transaction rollback contract cover selected failure cases and have negative/regression tests.
limitations: Policy validation does not prove every desktop or operating-system failure mode is recovered.

controls.title: Security, privileges and secret handling
controls.assessment: Authenticode inspection and the read-only product boundary are documented and regression-tested; the tool does not install or trust drivers automatically.
limitations: A signature result or hardware-ID match is evidence only; it is not proof of driver suitability or a security approval.

controls.title: Observability and diagnostics
controls.assessment: Versioned report envelopes and local snapshots preserve diagnostic evidence and have focused schema/export tests.
limitations: Reports are local diagnostic artifacts, not continuous telemetry or distributed traces.

controls.title: Performance budgets and capacity
controls.assessment: No verified service throughput, global memory budget or horizontal capacity baseline is defined for this single-machine workbench.
limitations: Gaming benchmark results do not establish backend service capacity or scalability.

controls.title: Configuration, extensibility and integration
controls.assessment: The plugin and federation contracts expose local extension points with tests for manifest and plugin boundaries.
limitations: Plugin discovery remains metadata-oriented; untrusted entrypoints are not loaded or executed automatically.

controls.title: Verification and delivery gate
controls.assessment: This PR adds a machine-readable backend engineering profile, safe-path/status validator, negative self-tests and a dedicated CI gate.
limitations: The gate validates profile integrity and evidence paths; it does not certify driver safety, Windows service behavior or production readiness.
